**About Clockwork Systems**



Clockwork.io – Software Driven Fabrics to increase GPU cluster utilization



Clockwork Systems was founded by Stanford researchers and veteran systems engineers who share a vision for redefining the foundations of distributed computing. As AI workloads grow increasingly complex, traditional infrastructure struggles to meet the demands of performance, reliability, and precise coordination. Clockwork is pioneering a software\-driven approach to AI fabrics by delivering cross\-stack observability to catch and quickly resolve problems, workload fault tolerance to keep jobs running through failures, and performance acceleration that dynamically routes and paces traffic to avoid congestion.



To learn more, visit www.clockwork.io.


**About the Role**
------------------



As our Senior HR Manager, you'll be the cornerstone of Clockwork's people function. This is a high\-impact, hands\-on role for someone who thrives in the builder phase: you'll own the full HR lifecycle, elevate our people programs, and serve as a trusted partner to leadership and employees alike. You'll work closely with our executive team to shape the culture, policies, and infrastructure that will carry us through our next phase of growth — including our teams in the U.S. and UK.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


**People Operations**


* Own end\-to\-end HR operations: onboarding, offboarding, employee lifecycle management, and HRIS administration.
* Partner with our PEO on payroll, benefits administration, and HR compliance.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for employee relations, resolving issues with empathy, fairness, and good judgment.


**Programs \& Policy**


* Design, implement, and continuously improve HR policies, employee handbooks, and operational processes that scale with the company.
* Lead compensation benchmarking, benefits strategy, and rewards programs to keep Clockwork competitive in the AI/infrastructure talent market.
* Build and deliver onboarding, training, and manager development programs that reinforce our values and accelerate employee effectiveness.


**Compliance \& Legal**


* Ensure compliance with federal, California, and UK employment laws and regulations.
* Oversee employment\-based immigration programs (H\-1B, green cards, etc.) in partnership with outside counsel.
* Proactively identify compliance risks and implement controls before they become problems.


**Strategic Partnership**


* Partner with leadership on workforce planning, org design, and headcount strategy as we scale.
* Track and report on people metrics (attrition, engagement, hiring velocity) and surface actionable insights.
* Support our UK employees with region\-appropriate HR programs and compliance requirements.
* Contribute to culture\-building initiatives, DEI programs, and employee engagement.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* **8–10\+ years** of progressive HR experience, with meaningful time in high\-growth startup or scale\-up environments.
* Demonstrated ability to build HR programs from scratch — not just maintain existing ones.
* Deep knowledge of California and U.S. employment law; familiarity with UK employment law is a strong plus.
* Hands\-on experience with compensation benchmarking, benefits administration, employee relations, performance management, and onboarding.
* Familiarity with employment\-based immigration processes (H\-1B, PERM, etc.).
* Experience working with PEOs and HRIS systems (e.g., Rippling, Gusto, BambooHR, or similar).
* Excellent judgment, discretion, and the ability to navigate ambiguity with confidence.
* Strong communicator who can build trust with engineers, executives, and everyone in between.
* Prior experience at a technical company or AI/infrastructure startup is a plus — you don't need to know how GPUs work, but you should be comfortable in that environment.

**Why Clockwork**
-----------------


* You'll be the owner — not a coordinator — of a people function that genuinely matters.
* Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits.
* An exceptional team solving hard, important problems at the intersection of AI and infrastructure.
* Palo Alto HQ with catered meals and a collaborative, low\-ego culture.
* The chance to shape the HR foundations of a company at an inflection point.


**Enjoy**


* Challenging projects.
* A friendly and inclusive workplace culture.
* Competitive compensation.
* A great benefits package.
* Catered lunches.


Compensation for this position will vary based on the skills and experience you bring, as well as internal equity considerations. For candidates hired at the posted level, the expected base salary range is $140,000 \- $180,000\. The offered compensation package may also include stock options or other equity awards, subject to Clockwork's equity program and applicable approvals.  

In addition to cash compensation, this role is eligible to participate in the company's equity program, which may include stock options granted in accordance with the company's equity plan and subject to approval and applicable vesting schedules.

**Clockwork Systems is an equal opportunity employer.** We are committed to building world\-class teams by welcoming bright, passionate individuals from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. We believe diversity drives innovation, and we grow stronger together.

title: Senior Technical Lead - IT Systems Engineer
description:
About OCS IT  
OCS IT is an award\-winning managed IT and cybersecurity provider based in Cape Coral, Florida. Most of our clients are medical practices, and we manage the systems they rely on every day: networks, phone systems, Microsoft 365, security and HIPAA compliance. We've been doing this for 18 years.

About the role  
The Senior Technical Lead is our most senior engineer and the escalation point for the service desk. Our clients run a mix of legacy on\-prem Active Directory and Microsoft 365, so you need to be comfortable in both. Strong networking, firewall and VoIP skills are required.

Responsibilities

* Administer and troubleshoot on\-prem Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS and DHCP, including older server versions
* Plan and run domain controller upgrades, file server migrations, and cleanup of inherited environments
* Administer Exchange Online, Entra ID, Intune, SharePoint and OneDrive; configure MFA and Conditional Access; manage hybrid identity with Entra Connect
* Deploy and manage firewalls, HA pairs and site\-to\-site IPsec VPN tunnels, including tunnels between different vendors
* Design and troubleshoot VLANs, routing, QoS and wireless networks
* Support FreePBX, Sangoma and Switchvox phone systems and SIP trunks using call logs and Wireshark
* Respond to security incidents, manage EDR and email security tools, and run vulnerability scans and remediate findings
* Build and maintain Hyper\-V hosts, failover clusters and virtual machines, including physical\-to\-virtual migrations
* Perform basic SQL Server management and backups for EHR and practice management databases
* Manage backups and test restores regularly
* Automate routine work with PowerShell and use AI tools for troubleshooting, scripting and documentation
* Lead client projects including scoping, scheduling and cutover
* Mentor Tier 1 and Tier 2 technicians and write team documentation
* Own escalations with carriers, software vendors and hardware manufacturers

Required

* 7\+ years of hands\-on IT experience, including 2\+ years in a senior, lead or mentoring role
* Strong on\-prem Active Directory and Group Policy experience
* Strong Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration
* Solid networking skills, including VLANs, routing and wireless
* Hands\-on firewall and IPsec VPN experience
* VoIP and SIP troubleshooting experience
* Hands\-on Hyper\-V experience, including host builds, failover clustering and VM migrations
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity tools and incident response
* Experience using AI tools in daily IT work
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation

Preferred

* Healthcare IT experience (EHR, practice management, HL7 interfaces, clinical devices), strongly preferred
* MSP experience
* Linux experience
* FortiGate experience

Work environment  
Fully on\-site at our Cape Coral office with travel to client sites. No remote or hybrid option. You'll take part in the after\-hours on\-call rotation and sometimes work evenings or weekends for migrations.

Compensation and benefits  
Salary starts at $90,000, based on experience. Paid time off, matching 401(k), health insurance reimbursement, and support for professional development and certifications.

Pay: From $90,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Paid time off

Metaview is an AI company focused on recruiting. We build AI agents that help world\-class companies hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate the toil, and augment the human for companies like Brex, Affirm, Deel, ElevenLabs, and Airtable.

* **Velocity.** Optimize for rate of learning. Take action, get feedback, get better.

* Partner with sales enablement and PMM to turn training and SMB competitive positioning into consistent execution across the team.

* Experience leading a high\-performing B2B sales team; depth of experience matters less than evidence that you are an exceptional leader.
* A record of delivering against sales quota in a high\-velocity motion and helping a team do the same.
* A builder’s mindset, with experience creating a qualification framework or sales process rather than only inheriting one.
* Strong, direct coaching and talent\-development skills, with the ability to raise the performance bar across a high volume of deals.
* Systems thinking: you can turn growth goals into useful pipeline standards, forecasting, and team rhythms without slowing reps down.
* Customer\-facing judgment and an understanding of seats\-based expansion, so you can help reps land accounts and grow them.
* High agency and high standards, with the comfort to build a new segment playbook alongside the team you lead.

You'll help health systems advance their enterprise imaging strategies by connecting clinical, technical, and business stakeholders with solutions that support their evolving imaging needs.
In this role, you'll develop and execute strategic sales plans, manage a healthy pipeline, and lead complex, multi\-stakeholder sales cycles. * Identify cross\-sell and upsell opportunities within Hyland's existing healthcare customer base, including opportunities to introduce enterprise imaging solutions to customers using other Hyland products.
* Lead complex, consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, technical requirements, and organizational decision\-making processes.
* Partner with sales solution engineers, product specialists, and other internal resources to develop and deliver compelling software demonstrations and customer presentations.

* Experience selling enterprise imaging, medical imaging, PACS, or related healthcare IT solutions.

* Ability to establish credibility, build trust, and communicate effectively with clinical, technical, and executive audiences.

title: Member of Mathematical Staff
description:
**At SF Tensor, we're building the future of high\-performance compute**
========================================================================


We firmly believe that the future of AI depends on the unglamorous: rethinking and rebuilding the stack, all the way down. From the hardware underneath it to the compiler targeting it and the cloud running it. Right now those three things fight each other and that friction shows up as a tax on every researcher trying to build something ambitious. We're here to axe that tax and make compute faster, cheaper and more available. When we succeed, compute will be portable enough that "which cloud, which chip" stop being something you worry about.


To achieve this, we are building our Kernel Optimizer, which takes code and finds its fastest possible form for whatever vendor and cluster topology you point it at, automatically, as well as the Model Foundry which manages the runs, makes research easier and moves workloads across clouds and chips as prices and availability ship, instead of leaving you locked into whatever vendor you signed with first.


We're backed by Susa Ventures, Y Combinator, along with some great funds and angels including Max Mullen and Paul Graham, as well as founders and executives at Neuralink, Notion and AMD. We're looking for researchers, engineers and organizations who agree with the basic premise: you don't get the next leap in AI without a leap in compute first.

**About the Role**
------------------


We build the fastest GPU compiler in the world. Most compilers have to preserve correctness at every transform, constraining how far they can search, while we prove correctness at the end instead, allowing us to search a far wider space, with agents, with RL, with anything that works and still guarantees the result. It's why we hold \#1 on NVIDIA's own kernel benchmark across hundreds of production kernels.


Our core proof machinery is real and it works, but right now there are some rough edges that limit the number of kernels we can prove. With the rise of AI capabilities in mathematics combined with our bit\-identical models and tools, such as our own model for large\-scale Lean proof writing, things that were nearly impossible just a few months ago are now totally viable, but we need someone who figures out what theory we're missing, builds it and then coordinates with the engineering team to deploy it at scale, which is why we are hiring a Member of Mathematical Staff to own the math behind the proof engine and other surfaces for applying rigorous math to an increasingly wishy\-washy domain.


This is not an advisory role and you'll have access to better tooling than anywhere else, such as bit\-exact software models of hardware components like the **tcgen05**, a compiler capable of emitting code at a lower level than publicly possible, and frontier models with capabilities tailored to what your work needs, trained with our team.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* You'll own the proof engine end\-to\-end, ensuring we can prove kernels across all edge cases
* You'll collaborate with the engineering team on building formal models of new hardware
* You'll work on formalizing numeric stability and what drives model convergence across diverse architectures
* You'll work on research around the extent to which we can predict training divergence during runs
* You'll collaborate with the research team on our post\-training efforts around formal proofs and program verification
* You'll work on formalizing low\-precision computation and its numerical stability
* You'll collaborate with the engineering team on formally proving sandboxes safe

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* A PhD in Math is strongly recommended but not required: what matters is what you've proven and built
* Someone with good judgement about when a full proof is worth it and when a cheaper guarantee is enough
* Someone who's pragmatic about tooling and knows when SMT works, when an interactive proof is necessary and when custom decision procedures are necessary
* Someone who's comfortable owning an open\-ended problem where you set the research agenda yourself
* Someone who can explain a proof strategy to an engineer who doesn't know the math, and push back when they want to cut corners

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Someone who's contributed to projects such as Mathlib, Flocq or seL4\.
* Someone with hands\-on experience working with Lean or Rocq
* Someone who's done work or published in the field of program verification
* Someone who's done work or published in the field of numerical analysis or numerics
* Someone who's done work or published in the field of optimization theory or the dynamics of stochastic training
* Someone with deep knowledge in the field of floating\-point formalization

**Why Join Us**
---------------


You will sit in the only place in the world right now working on guaranteeing the correctness and training stability of frontier models, which is one of the most important problems of our time, with the tools and freedom to actually solve it. The truth is that most formal methods work never leaves the paper and most ML work never gets near a proof. Here, the proof engine decides what is allowed to ship into production, so your work sits on the critical path of everything we do and gets tested against more kernels in a day than most verification tools see in their lifetime.


We invest heavily in AI tooling for mathematics, from our own model for large\-scale Lean proof writing to bit\-exact models of the hardware, so you spend your time on the theory and not the tedium, and get from idea to proof as fast as possible. Beyond that, the people who reverse\-engineered the tensor cores, write the compiler and train the models you are proving and using for your mathematics are the same people you eat lunch with, so when a proof hinges on what the silicon actually does, the answer is a conversation away.


We're a small team operating at frontier scale. We pre\-trained foundation models on 4,000 AMD GPUs as a team of three, designed and brought up GB300 NVL72 clusters and designed a TOP500 supercomputer.


We believe that hard problems get solved in person and most of our work happens at our office in San Francisco. We offer relocation assistance and, where possible, we'd like you here as often as possible.


The base salary range for this full\-time position is $225,000\-$315,000, plus meaningful equity and benefits.


Compensation Range: $225K \- $315K

description:
The Senior Production Planner owns production planning and schedule execution for complex or high\-mix programs within assigned value streams. This role develops and maintains executable production schedules aligned with the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and customer delivery commitments while coordinating cross\-functional actions to resolve constraints and protect schedule performance.  

The role proactively manages risks related to material availability, production capacity, quality holds, and technical issues, driving recovery plans and escalating issues when necessary to maintain delivery performance.  

Production Planning \& Scheduling

* Develop and maintain executable production schedules aligned with MPS and customer contract dates
* Sequence production builds based on delivery commitments, material availability, and capacity constraints
* Monitor schedule health and adjust priorities to maintain schedule stability and execution

  

Schedule Execution \& Recovery

* Drive recovery plans for schedule disruptions including material shortages, quality holds, technical issues, and capacity limitations
* Coordinate cross\-functional actions with Operations, Quality, Procurement, and Program Management to resolve production constraints
* Escalate risks through Tier 2 / Tier 3 forums with clear mitigation plans

  

Capacity \& Production Flow

* Monitor production capacity constraints including testing, burn\-in, seal windows, labor availability, and key production resources

Program Visibility \& Communication

Cross\-Functional Coordination

Decision Authority

* Escalation of program risks and recommended mitigation actions

  

Performance Metrics

* On\-Time Delivery (OTD)

* Past Due Backlog (PDB) reduction
* Schedule adherence and execution reliability

* Minimum five (5\) years of experience in production planning, manufacturing, supply chain, or a related functional discipline. A Master’s degree may substitute for two (2\) years of experience, with a minimum of three (3\) years of applicable experience required.

title: Design Infrastructure Engineer (EDA & Test)
description:
WaveWorks makes wireless communication solutions for the next wave of connected devices. WaveWorks' unique technology provides extremely low cost, small form factor, and orders of magnitude lower power consumption, while achieving long operating range and high reliability. WaveWorks is expanding its engineering team and searching for high performing, dedicated individuals to help blaze new trails.

 **ROLE DESCRIPTION**



WaveWorks is looking for a strong software and systems engineer to own the engineering environment its silicon team depends on. That environment is built on the Synopsys, Cadence and Siemens EDA tool suites, alongside other EDA and lab tools. The role covers the software, compute, EDA, data and automation infrastructure behind chip design, bring\-up, characterization and test. The goal is an engineering environment that runs like a mature production system: reliable, reproducible and able to scale, with tooling and infrastructure work taken off the IC designers.



The right person will be given authority to direct information and IT infrastructure for a complex, deep\-stack technology startup building a multi\-faceted platform.

  

This is not a chip design role and not corporate IT. The engineer is the technical owner of the systems that let analog, digital and verification designers do their jobs, and the software generalist the silicon team turns to when a new need appears. EDA tools are the first priority, but the scope is deliberately broad.

 **EDA ENVIRONMENT**

  

* Install, configure and maintain the Synopsys, Cadence and Siemens EDA tool suites, their license servers, and other EDA tools, and make them work together reliably in one design environment.
* Own the knowledge of how the design environment is assembled, and document it so that it does not depend on any one designer.
* Open and track support tickets, reproduce and report failures, coordinate work with vendors, and drive issues to closure.

  

  

**COMPUTE AND ENGINEERING INFRASTRUCTURE**


* Run engineering workstations, compute servers, shared storage, and access control.
* Build reproducible development environments, software deployment, and automation, including CI\-style workflows around design and test.

  


**TEST AND CHARACTERIZATION SOFTWARE**


* Build bench\-test automation and instrument\-control software for silicon bring\-up and characterization.
* Build the pipeline for test data: acquisition, experiment metadata, parsing, storage, statistical analysis, plotting and reports.
* Build regression and automated test suites, and tools to compare results across devices, lots, temperatures, configurations and silicon revisions.
  


**ENGINEERING DATA**


* Organize design files, test data, generated artifacts and technical documentation so they are stored predictably, versioned, searchable, tagged with metadata, and available to the right people.
* Own version control across engineering: Git for software, scripts and configuration, and design data management for design libraries and PDKs, with branching, release and access practices the whole team follows.
* Structure engineering data so later analysis and automation are possible.
  


**INTERNAL SOFTWARE**


* Write the internal tools, scripts, data pipelines, hardware\-control software and build tooling that the silicon team needs, including one\-off software to unblock a hardware engineer.
* Use AI coding agents and modern tools as a standard part of the work, to build internal software quickly and remove recurring manual overhead.
  


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* BS in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field plus 3 or more years of software or systems engineering experience, or an MS plus 1 or more years.
* Strong software engineering in Python and at least one other language, with a record of building and maintaining tools other engineers rely on.
* Expert use of Git and version\-control workflows, including repository administration.
* Deep Linux systems administration: servers, storage, networking, user and access management, and scripting.
* DevOps practice: configuration management, reproducible environments, containers, CI, and automation of repetitive work.
* Daily, effective use of AI coding agents and assistants in engineering work.
* High autonomy and breadth: able to take ownership of an undefined problem, such as a new test suite, and deliver it without close direction.
* Enjoys building critical infrastructure and wants to own it.

  


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Experience administering Synopsys, Cadence or Siemens EDA tools, including license servers and design\-environment setup.
* Familiarity with IC design flows, PDKs, and design data management.
* Lab automation and instrument control for semiconductor bring\-up or characterization.
* Data engineering and statistical analysis of large test data sets.
* Experience working with EDA or other technical vendors on support and escalation.
* Firmware or embedded software experience.
* Experience at a semiconductor or hardware startup.

  



With its unique technology, WaveWorks is positioned to meet the needs of a plethora of applications of wireless connectivity that are not well served by conventional wireless solutions. Join us as we work to capture this opportunity and become a significant force in wireless.

  

WaveWorks is committed to a friendly and welcoming working environment, and has a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. WaveWorks does not discriminate based on race, gender, age, religious affiliation, or any other legally protected status.
